title: Ledger Vision
tagline: See every token you own across all wallets & chains in one secure Ledger Live Dapp.
description:
Ledger Live is an on-chain portfolio aggregator integrated directly into Ledger Live.
Crypto users often juggle multiple wallets and chains, making it nearly impossible to track their true net worth. By simply adding their addresses—without even signing in with their wallet—they instantly access a secure, unified dashboard showing all tokens and portfolio evolution across every chain at once.

Built inside Ledger’s trusted environment, it’s privacy-first, simple, and future-ready.
how_its_made:
We built on the Ledger Device Management Kit and integrated directly into Ledger Live. A custom engine aggregates balances across multiple chains (via RPCs + Ethers.js/Wagmi) and fetches real-time prices from CoinGecko to show portfolio value.

Users only add public addresses—no signatures or private keys—so everything runs securely client-side.
